fields.name: layout_padding
fields.label: Section Padding
fields.description: Combines the source's noTopPadding/noBottomPadding checkboxes into one field, the same technique wrs-four-column-listing uses (see docs/wrs-migration-notes.md), so the two booleans never land in the same grouped cell with no way to tell which is which.

fields.name: color_body
fields.label: Content Body Default Color
fields.description: Hex or CSS colour value. This field, and the seven below, are all freeform colour text - there is no colorfield component in this project's Universal Editor field set, matching the same 'text' idiom used everywhere else in this repo for a free colour value (see docs/wrs-migration-notes.md ## backgroundsection). All eight are explicitly prefixed color_ so none of them accidentally collapse into a sibling via the model-build suffix rule - contentBody + Title/Text are exactly the Title/Text suffixes the xwalk max-cells linter collapses onto a base field named contentBody, which would silently have merged three distinct colours into one had the original field names been kept as-is.

fields.name: image_kind

fields.description: Structural marker - identifies this row as an image slide on a published page, where no editor instrumentation is present to ask. Always Image.

fields.name: image_fetchPriority
fields.label: Enable High Fetch Priority

fields.name: content_textAlignment

fields.name: content_bottomSpacing
fields.label: CTA Bottom Spacing (%)
fields.description: To use only for mastheads without text. Sets the spacing from the bottom of the masthead (source dialog default: 15%). Applies to the whole text/CTA panel, matching the source - it is a property of the panel, not of the CTA button alone.

fields.name: countdown_gmt
fields.label: GMT
fields.description: The source dialog populated this from a live OSGi datasource (~600 java.util.TimeZone ids). That has no Universal Editor equivalent, so this is a curated finite list: Singapore (the site's primary market, and the source servlet's own default) plus the other Mandai-relevant Asia-Pacific and major source-market zones. If a broader zone is needed, extend this list rather than inventing an unbounded free-text field.
